question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- For each year, constructor: find best driver points and constructor total points, then combine
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, d.driver_id, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name, SUM(res.points) as driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
    WHERE res.points IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name, d.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, constructor_name, driver_id, driver_name, driver_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, constructor_id ORDER BY driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM driver_points
),
constructor_total AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, SUM(res.points) as constructor_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE res.points IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
)
SELECT bd.constructor_name, bd.year, bd.driver_name, bd.driver_points, ct.constructor_points, 
       bd.driver_points + ct.constructor_points as combined_points
FROM best_driver bd
JOIN constructor_total ct ON bd.year = ct.year AND bd.constructor_id = ct.constructor_id
WHERE bd.rn = 1
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
